task: Driver upload stalls observed for Sety and Dao, after the October 16 fix
scope: Photo upload transport only; preserve automatic recovery, retained photos, and completion/save behavior.

evidence.Sety: 2026-10-19: all 960262 photo bytes sent; confirmation missing; browser hidden; 180000 ms timer fired 173746 ms late. This is consistent with browser suspension, not proof of why the device became hidden.
evidence.Dao: Three uploads failed with HTTP status 0 after 55%, 77%, and 83% of bytes. Browser diagnostics cannot distinguish a radio outage, connection reset, or OS interruption. All retries succeeded.

behaviors: W1: Stop an upload after 30000 ms without new bytes, including before the first progress event; report a retryable timeout and preserve the photo.
W2: After the request body finishes, wait at most 15000 ms for storage confirmation; 100% sent is never treated as an acknowledged object.
W3: Extend the idle deadline only when transferred bytes increase. Steady slow transfers may exceed 30 seconds within the existing total budget.
W4: Set the native XHR timeout as well as a JavaScript watchdog; check expired phase deadlines on pageshow/visibilitychange so delayed timers cannot restart a stale wait.

W5: Request a screen wake lock while uploading, reacquire on return to the page, and release on success, failure, cancellation, or late acquisition. Denial, absence, or a pending request cannot block uploading.
W6: Existing reconnect retries an interrupted upload with the same photo bytes and does not resend already acknowledged photos; all existing recovery contracts remain in force.
W7: Acknowledge success only after a valid storage response; remove timers and lifecycle listeners after every outcome.
W8: Update the upload asset URL and driver shell cache so reloaded clients receive the change.

setup.dependencies: None added; use existing pinned Node, ESLint, TypeScript, fast-check, c8, Playwright toolchain.
setup.git: No commits, resets, or unrelated edits.
setup.runner: Custom bounded Docker harness wrapped by docker/retention/retention.py; all transient output in MBBS_TEST_ARTIFACT_DIR; teardown registered before launch.
setup.testData: Synthetic photos and local HTTP storage fixture only; no production database or real storage writes.
setup.files: Focused unit/property/browser tests, reproducible checks and deployment tool, concise evidence; production changes limited to driver-upload.js and cache/version references.

contractRevision: The old exact two-timer assertion becomes three independent deadlines (authorization, total transfer, progress idle). Its original authorization and total timeout budgets remain unchanged.
limitations: No browser code can run while the OS has suspended it. A screen wake lock is best effort and cannot prevent app switching or repair a lost mobile connection.
No historical storage-worker request trace is available in this workspace; the physical cause of Dao's network failures remains unproven.

The whole application's unrelated suites are outside this scoped browser transport change; run all existing driver upload/recovery/reconnect unit and property suites plus real Chromium/WebKit transport checks.
